why: Issue #617. The stated tick budget is never checked, so a game that stopped ending plays on until the recipe's wall-clock timeout kills the runner, and the failure reads as a slow or broken capture instead of "the game did not end". The acceptance criterion is exactly that exceeding the budget fails with a message naming the unmet predicate.
killedBy: steps.mjs: advancePlay, the verdict of a played step fails an over-budget run as "the game did not end", naming the selector, counted across worlds
